composed: check_hand over each question, entry_unbacked over each option

questions.question: The prev-mode dry of standing-b2d does not finish within the 590 s guard of tools/standing/prevdry.py :97: three sends ended at it, and its sources() timed through the tool's own child route, with no guard and no bank written, read OK with 256 sources in 650.2 s (data/b767_defects.txt :441), where b766's part took 584.2 s (data/b766_prevdry_standing-b2d.json :7). The other nine parts read SOURCES OK at the act module's blob, standing-b2c at its fifth send in 587.0 s (data/b767_defects.txt :427). The lock gate reads every part's bank OK, and N2 moves tools/standing/ by the commit of (8) alone, so the seat cannot lock without b2d's bank. The host's own programs were busy beside the act at the last sample. How shall the seat go on?

options.label: Keep sending b2d (Recommended)
options.description: The seat sends standing-b2d again, alone and in the foreground, each send that ends at the guard lettered, until it reads SOURCES OK or until 07:30Z, then puts this question again; the author may pause the host's other programs to give the part the host. Nothing moves in tools/standing/ and no score's clause is touched by this route.

options.label: Amend the guard
options.description: The navigator writes an amendment, for the author's paste, raising tools/standing/prevdry.py's 590 s guard for this act, and the seat waits for it before the lock; tools/standing/ then moves beyond the commit of (8), which N2 reads REFUTED unless the amendment's row names it.

options.label: Halt before the lock
options.description: The act stops here, before the lock: nothing locked, sealed or closed, the banks committed as they stand; the next ruling takes the act up from the relay's head.
